title: Introducing MCP Server Configurations for Business Central (Part 2)

chapters.title: Call to action and next steps

features.name: MCP Server Configurations
features.description: Ability to create named configurations in Business Central to control what data and functionality is exposed through MCP, allowing you to specify which API pages and actions are available, limit access to read-only or enable write/delete operations.
features.status_evidence_quote: the MCP server is currently in preview this is work in progress
caveats: Currently only supports API pages, expansion planned
Copilot Studio supports up to 70 tools

features.name: Dynamic Tool Mode
features.description: Instead of preloading all tools into the MCP server, dynamic tool mode allows tools to be discovered on demand using an action search tool.
caveats: Tools are not available from the beginning when enabled

features.name: Discover Additional Objects
features.description: A toggle setting that allows the MCP client to find API pages which are not explicitly listed in the available tools configuration.

features.name: Bound Actions in MCP
features.description: Any method or bound action exposed as part of an API page can also be called by the LLM or agent, exposed in the same way as in normal OData APIs.

features.name: MCP Read-Only Default
features.description: The default MCP configuration grants read access only, ensuring agents cannot inadvertently change data without explicit configuration.

features.name: MCP Authentication Model
features.description: MCP uses the same authentication and permission model as APIs, including support for entitlements and permissions.
